Look at the details of this HUGE MiG 29 RC Jet! It has the Red Star livery, used by the actual air show team on a MiG with thrust vectoring. It’s 1/9 scale, and running two 80mm EDFs that move a ton of air. Rotating metal landing gear with sequential doors, huge battery bay so you can fit two 6s Lipo batteries to power this monster.
